note: Short local healing runs comparing carve geometries, written 2026-11-02 before either run. The user: 'ok, let's keep going with the 128 and no shared expert healing run'. Same student, data, LoRA and loss as the 2026-10-29 pilot (heal_rules.json); only the MLP carve differs. 1M tokens each with a full cosine schedule, so neither run matches the pilot's 1M milestone, which was taken at near-peak learning rate. Today's carve is healed the same way so the comparison is like for like. Local GPU (Radeon 8060S), no pod. Code: heal_geometry.py (slim_heal.py's heal stage with the carve swapped).

predictions.start: Before training, S0_K24 starts below S1536_K9 by about the MLP-only learned-router gap (1.167 vs 1.288): combined KL about 1.37 against 1.49.
predictions.baseline_1m: S1536_K9 reaches KL 0.70-0.76 at 1M tokens (the pilot's 1M milestone was 0.766 at near-peak learning rate; a finished schedule should do a little better).
predictions.ranking: S0_K24 is still below S1536_K9 at 1M tokens, paired document bootstrap within domains, upper 95% bound below 0.
predictions.gap: The gap shrinks with healing: at 1M it is under two thirds of the gap at 0 tokens.
predictions.recall: Router recall rises during healing for both; S0_K24 stays above S1536_K9 (0.76 vs 0.68 before healing, MLP-only).

criteria.screening: If ranking holds, unhealed learned-router KL is a usable screen for carve geometry, and later geometries can be screened locally without healing; if it fails, only healed comparisons count.

S0_K24.note: c=128, 96 experts, 24 per token, no shared expert. No combined-model measurement exists for this carve, so the start is recorded, not checked.

S1536_K9.note: today's carve (c=168, 50% shared, 9 per token); must reproduce the combined model (KL 1.491) before training, as the pilot did

S0_K24_4M.note: S0_K24 healed on from its 1M state to about 4M tokens, written 2026-11-03 before the run. The user: 'heal locally, outputting new results every hour.' The data order continues where S0_K24 stopped (step 62, so every token is new); the optimizers start fresh (S0_K24 kept no optimizer state) with a 5-step warmup back to the peak rate and a cosine over the 184 remaining steps. A milestone about every hour (28 steps): KL on the eval set and a GSM8K probe on the first 48 check prompts, sampled at 2,048 and greedy at 1,024. The first milestone, before training, must reproduce S0_K24's last (0.730) and gives the probe's baseline.

predictions.restart: The warm restart costs a little at first: KL at the first milestone after training (1.47M) is within 0.02 of 0.730, above or below.
predictions.kl_4m: KL at 4.03M is 0.60 to 0.67 (the 9-expert pod heal reached 0.766 at 1M; S0_K24 is 0.047 better at 1M and the gap shrinks with healing).
predictions.sampled: Sampled right answers at 2,048 rise from the start's (about 7 of 48) to 12 to 20 of 48 by 4M; the 9-expert pod model after 8.2M got 48 of 96 at 4,096.
predictions.greedy: Greedy loops at 1,024 fall, but most of the 48 still loop at 4M (over 30).

predictions.start: held (1.366 vs 1.490; baseline reproduces the combined model, 1.490 vs 1.491)
predictions.baseline_1m: failed narrowly: 0.776, above the 0.70-0.76 range and the pilot 1M milestone (0.766) despite the finished schedule
predictions.gap: held: 0.047 is 0.38 of the 0.124 start gap
predictions.recall: half: S1536_K9 rose 0.680 -> 0.698; S0_K24 dipped and came back (0.765 -> 0.763); S0_K24 stayed above

outcome.reading: The unhealed ranking survives 1M tokens of healing, at about 40% of its size. Unhealed learned-router KL is usable as a screen for order, not for magnitude.
outcome.local: Training runs on the local GPU: 126 tokens/s, 26 GB, micro-batch 2 held; 1M tokens plus four evaluations take about 2.6 hours per run.
